notes_md: 本对象为 MIG-B2/M2 转录组 A 页面注册身份件：源 outputs/frontend/10_planned/application-page-registry.yaml（扩展名 .yaml、内容为 JSON）pages[] 共 35 条逐条转录之一（PAGE-TASK-STEP-AUTHENTICATE）。源条目（id/name/nav_group/template/prototype_fn/layout/columns/status/note/blocked 字段闭集）以 payload.page_entry 整条逐字保真（与源条目字节等价，工具断言）；数组顺序=源顺序。status 语义登记（payload.registry_status_semantics）：源 status=existing-task-step 为 surface-kind 分类（新应用页 vs 既有 BP 派生任务步页），非审批/接线/变更语义——batch1 约定书 §4 拆分自检三连均不适用，双轴拆分动作=0、superseded_status_field 登记=0（诚实零，golden case 第 10 行同款）；blocked 旗标缺席（诚实缺席）。别名收编：PAGE-TASK-STEP-AUTHENTICATE → facet PAGE.REGISTRY.AUTHENTICATE（ALIASES_V0 已登记族 PAGE-TASK-STEP-*→PAGE.*，token 重排，02b §7 判例 PAGE.BIND_CARLINE 同形取余段）；legacy 词形照录 aliases[]，对象 origin=ingested（A6 场景，batch1 约定书 §6 OBS-3 裁定口径）。页级 id PAGE.AUTHENTICATE 由并发 page-surface 蓝图对象族持有，本 facet 取 PAGE.REGISTRY.* 作用域段避让（payload.id_facet 机器登记），Owner 裁决后经 supersede 链合并，绝不自动裁决。册级语义不在本对象：book_facet_pointer 指向单一承载位 PAGE.REGISTRY.APP_DASHBOARD（pages[0] 源序机械规则），分母漂移史/册级字段值不复制到兄弟对象（batch2 §5 重复登记即分叉隐患）。key_bindings.code 机械锚：prototype_ref 文件 + payload.page_entry.prototype_fn 期望声明（match_rule=mechanical），probe 缺省=未探测（gate 必须重扫，C5）。 本字段为人类散文，机器永不解析判卷。

book_facet_pointer.rule: book-level semantics single-carrier registration (pages[0] source array order); value duplication across siblings is a fork hazard and is forbidden (batch2 §5)

id_facet.rule: facet-scoped id per the group-B PAGE.READINESS.* convention: concurrent page-surface transcription families hold the page-level ids in this kind-dir (ALIASES_V0 canonical PAGE.<SEG> for PAGE-TASK-STEP-*; underscore PAGE.APP_* and dotted PAGE.APP.* drafts both observed for PAGE-APP-*); this facet takes the PAGE.REGISTRY.* scoping segment to avoid same-id clobber and merges via the supersede chain after Owner id adjudication (report only, never auto-adjudicate)

registry_status_semantics.honest_zero_reason: batch1 约定书 §4 拆分自检三连：非批准（注册在案即基线事实）、非接线（接线态归 readiness/blueprint 轴）、非变更（变更史归 change 轴）——surface-kind 分类不触发双轴拆分，诚实零登记
registry_status_semantics.semantics: surface-kind classification (new application page vs existing BP-derived task-step page), NOT an approval/progress/wiring/change status

locator.transcription: registry pages[] entry PAGE-TASK-STEP-AUTHENTICATE transcribed row-by-row verbatim (payload.page_entry byte-equal); status=existing-task-step registered as surface-kind classification (axis split 0, superseded_status_field 0 = honest zero); id action: facet-scoped rename per ALIASES_V0 remainder, origin=ingested (A6)
